review_headline: Just a whisper shy of perfection!
review_body: Service gets a tiny deduction. To be fully transparent, my minor issue appears to be fedex related. This was a college grad gift. I ordered and would have gladly expedited the shipping if I had realized it might not make it as promised. But, the promised delivery date was 2 days before I needed it. The shipment was delayed, likely by Fedex and didn’t arrive when promised. But, the tracking also didn’t update. So, both myself and customer service were left in limbo. The package wound up arriving to my address the afternoon of the graduation ceremony. Two hours away from campus. The graduate left for her trip of a lifetime graduation gift from her parents the next day. Without her gorgeous gift from her godmother (me). Just a disappointing experience for timing only. However, the PearlSource was gracious and went way above and beyond to apologize and offered ways to make it right (including offering to ship a second pair for overnight delivery). I cannot compliment them and their response more favorably! In the end, she will get her gift when she returns and will have a keepsake for hopefully generations to come. The earrings are exquisite! The gift box and just the general presentation is exquisite! They are on par with pricing at chain jewelry stores that don’t offer the same quality and service! If FedEx would have seen this through it would have been a flawless review. I will absolutely order again! I highly recommend the PearlSource for quality, price and customer satisfaction! Just a warning to err on the side of caution if you have a tight turnaround for delivery.

review_headline: They Helped Make Our 30th Anniversary Special
review_body:
Beautiful earrings, but what impressed me most was the customer service.

I ordered a pair of Akoya pearl earrings as a gift for my wife's 30th anniversary. After placing the order, I sent a note explaining that it would be wonderful if they could arrive before our anniversary dinner, although I understood that shipping timelines aren't always predictable.

To my surprise, The Pearl Source responded quickly, packed the order right away, and had it in the hands of FedEx the same day. Thanks to their efforts, the earrings arrived ahead of schedule and I was able to present them to my wife before our special dinner.

The earrings are beautiful, but it's the combination of quality products and genuine customer care that earned this five-star review. When a company takes the time to help make an important occasion a little more special, it deserves recognition.

Thank you, The Pearl Source.

review_headline: Gorgeous Akoya Hanadama Pearls and Outstanding Customer Service
review_body:
I recently received my beautiful white Japanese Hanadama Akoya pearls necklace (7.5–8 mm, 18” length), and I absolutely adore it. The pearls are stunning, with outstanding quality and a beautiful lustre, and the necklace is a perfect match to my Akoya Hanadama pearl earrings.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Lauren, Audrey, and the other team members at The Pearl Source for their dedication, professionalism, and for truly going the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction. Their attention to detail and care throughout the process made the experience feel very personal and reassuring.

I also found the informative videos on their website extremely helpful. The videos explaining the different pearl types, pearl sizes, necklace lengths, and overtones gave me a much better understanding of pearls and helped me make a confident decision. I think this kind of educational information is incredibly valuable for customers.

Another wonderful detail was that my necklace arrived with an independent PSL (Pearl Science Laboratory) report from Japan, which made the purchase feel even more reassuring in terms of authenticity and quality.

The presentation was absolutely beautiful as well. The necklace arrived in a very elegant and presentable jewellery box with a gorgeous velvet lining inside. The box itself feels very special and protective — there is no need for an additional jewellery box because the pearls can be stored safely and beautifully in this original presentation box.

The overseas delivery was impressively fast, customs support was handled very professionally, and the parcel tracking process was straightforward and easy to follow.

Overall, I had an excellent experience and would highly recommend The Pearl Source to anyone looking to purchase high-quality pearl jewellery.

The online shopping experience hinges on trust and reliability, and while occasional mishaps are inevitable, the true measure of a company lies in its response to such issues. My recent experience with The PearlSource began with disappointment: my package arrived, but the jewelry I had ordered was not in the box. However, the swift and effective action of their customer service team ultimately transformed a negative situation into a positive one, leaving me with a beautiful piece of jewelry and a favorable impression of the company.

Initially, the discovery that my package was empty was understandably frustrating. The anticipation of receiving the jewelry quickly turned into concern and the inconvenience of having to address the problem. However, The PearlSource's customer service team proved to be remarkably responsive and helpful. Upon contacting them, I was met with understanding and a genuine desire to rectify the situation. They promptly investigated the matter and, arranged for a replacement to be sent.

The speed and efficiency with which The PearlSource handled my complaint were particularly impressive. There was no lengthy back-and-forth, and no attempts to deflect responsibility. Instead, they focused on resolving the issue quickly and effectively. This commitment to customer satisfaction speaks volumes about the company's values and its dedication to providing a positive shopping experience.

Ultimately, the replacement package arrived, and the jewelry is, as described, beautiful. The quality of the piece was evident, and it was clear that The PearlSource takes pride in the products they offer. While the initial problem was certainly unwelcome, the exceptional service I received in resolving it ultimately overshadowed the negative start :)

review_headline: Missed delivery deadline, then extended it instead of honouring the promised refund
review_body:
Ordered from SHEIN with a stated delivery window of 23–27 July 2026. The parcel reached the destination airport and then sat there for six days with no tracking movement, and was never released to the local courier.

On 27 July, a customer service representative confirmed in writing, in the app chat, to reach out again the next day and request a full refund then if the order does not. It was not delivered.

I contacted customer service again on 28 July, as instructed. Rather than the promised refund as per the policy of missed ETA deadline, the delivery deadline was moved to 3 August without my agreement.

Customer service was polite throughout (although fully automated bot, not a human being in sight), but every reply repeated the same three points regardless of what I asked: an apology, a request to wait longer, and a note that intercepting the parcel "may fail."

There was no way to reach a supervisor or anyone able to approve a refund directly, and the only concrete option offered was to refuse a delivery that no courier had yet attempted.

I've kept screenshots of the original delivery window, the written refund commitment, and the later change of date, in case anyone from SHEIN wants to look into it.

All I received is a link with a tracking code to track the local courier. However, the package has not even been handed to the local courier and the customer support representative still keeps insisting to check with the courier.

What I'd flag for other buyers is what happens after a delivery date is missed: the promised refund process didn't hold up in my case. Be very careful and cautious. I'll update this review if that changes.


IPDATE, 29 July: SHEIN's reply to this review below asks me to check my email for a resolution, suggesting it may have gone to spam. I did receive their email - it does not contain a resolution, it repeats the same request to wait, this time until 3 August. The reply to this review describes an email that doesn't match the one I actually got.

SHEIN refused to address the issue with nonsensical/irrelevant responses to my demands for a full refund. SHEIN should first and foremost stop misrepresenting products and definitely should fully refund customers when they are called out for doing so.

After I sent them a screenshot proving it had already exceeded the promised timeframe twice, yes folks twice, they changed their story and admitted it was late.  

To make matters worse, the shipping company suddenly claimed my address was "unshippable"—even though they had already successfully delivered other packages to the exact same address. Then Shein turned around and canceled it, refunded the funds yet I was told by the shipping company it would be delivered the following day.  Which of course was untrue. Now they want 3 more days.  

I'm still waiting for my order with no real answers or resolution. Poor customer service, conflicting information, refusal to get a manager and zero accountability. I won't be ordering again. I highly recommend not going through the hassle especially if you want your items within the timeframe promised.

review_headline: Received Another Customer’s Order, Then SHEIN Denied It
review_body:
I ordered $166.27 worth of merchandise from SHEIN and never received the items I actually purchased.

Instead, my package contained another customer’s order, including that customer’s packing slip with a different name and shipping address. The clothing I received did not match my order at all.

I immediately contacted SHEIN and submitted extensive evidence, including:

* Photos of the items I actually received.
* The other customer’s packing slip that was inside my package.
* My original order showing what I purchased.
* Additional documentation proving the merchandise did not match my order.

Despite this, SHEIN repeatedly denied my claim, stating that their warehouse confirmed my package was shipped correctly. They have never explained how another customer’s packing slip ended up inside my package if there was supposedly no fulfillment error.

Rather than acknowledging that I never received the merchandise I paid for, I was simply told to return the package as if this were a standard return.

I have since had to file a dispute with Klarna, a complaint with the Better Business Bureau, and a report with the FTC because I have been unable to get SHEIN to address the evidence or issue a refund.

My biggest frustration is not just the fulfillment mistake—mistakes happen. It’s that even after providing clear documentation, including another customer’s packing slip, SHEIN refused to explain how that could happen while insisting there was no warehouse error.

I expected much better customer service and accountability.

I have reviewed Shein about one week ago, but have just now received my latest package.

The Three Pens:
I have had no issues with them. They were all great quality and looked stunning. It was a bit expensive for 3 pens though.

The  Carpet:
I hated it. It was horrible. The only good thing about it was the size. The carpet had a Koi carp / Japanese artwork on it. Which looked great on the photo's. But when it arrived, it had white patches that had no color. The carpet was also folded so badly that it can hardly be used as a carpet.

The T-Shirt:
It had a very fun and happy artwork on it. Other than that, awful. The color of the shirt was a disgusting yellow. Not the same as in the picture. Size L feels more like a size M and the fabric used is just terrible. It's extremely hot and looks like a wrinkled gym shirt.

I don't see myself ever buying clothing on Shein again, nor carpets. 2/5 stars.

review_headline: Good value, but delivery felt uncertain
review_body: Shein offers a very broad range of current styles at accessible prices, and the dress I ordered fit well and felt better than I expected for the cost. The product gave me good value, but the process around it was less polished. Shipping took longer than expected, tracking updates were inconsistent, and the way the dress was packed left deep creases that required steaming before it was wearable. The company's main strength is making trend-led clothing easy to browse and affordable to try. The weaknesses in this order were logistics, communication, and presentation on arrival. I would consider ordering again when I am not in a hurry, but more reliable tracking and better packaging would make the experience feel much more considered.

review_headline: I returned the item(s) according to…
review_body:

On 24/05/2026, I submitted an official return request within the timeframe permitted by SHEIN's policy. The merchant issued a return request and a pickup label via their designated courier company, HFD

Subsequently, customer support ceased responding, stalled without offering any resolution, and ultimately blocked me from accessing their support channels entirely.

Summary:

review_headline: Shein isn't what it used to be
review_body:
Shein isn't what it used to be, frustrating experience. 

​I’ve been a loyal customer for a long time, but Shein is honestly not what it used to be. Lately, the service has gone downhill completely.
​Inaccurate Stock: I keep finding that products are listed incorrectly regarding their actual availability.
​Shipping & Lost Packages: Delivery times are now painfully long, and to make matters worse, packages frequently get lost in transit.
​Terrible Customer Support: Trying to get help is a nightmare. There is virtually no real customer support anymore.
​No Refunds: If your package goes missing, it is now incredibly difficult to actually get a refund. They make you jump through endless hoops.
​While I still find many items that interest me, the constant headaches mean I will think twice before ordering from them again. Proceed with caution.

Very poor experience with SHEIN’s refund process.

I placed an order in December 2025, but the package never arrived. After reporting the issue, I had to go through a refund process that took almost a month, with several emails, incomplete responses, and repeated requests for information.

From the beginning, I asked for the refund to be issued as SHEIN Wallet credit, because I had already experienced problems with bank refunds before. Later, their support team asked me for an alternative account to process the refund, so I provided my PayPal account.

However, only a small portion of the refund, around USD 15, was sent to PayPal. The rest was sent in several split amounts to my bank account, which was exactly the method I had asked them to avoid.

The biggest issue is that I originally paid for the order in one single transaction, not in separate payments. Therefore, if SHEIN decided to refund the original card, they should have refunded the exact amount corresponding to the original card transaction, not several fragmented amounts. Because of this, my bank is not properly recognizing or releasing part of the refund, since the amounts do not match the original purchase transaction.

This makes the situation even more frustrating. Why ask me where I wanted the refund to be sent if, in the end, they were going to process it however they wanted, without following the refund method I provided?

As a result, after almost a month of emails, claims, and additional paperwork with my bank, I still cannot access a significant part of my money.

This has been a very frustrating and poorly managed refund process. SHEIN should have respected the refund method I requested, or at least processed the refund correctly according to the original transaction.

Unfortunately, based on this experience, I cannot recommend SHEIN’s customer service or refund process.

The report number is: 57232576.

review_headline: I used to highly trust Shein and other…
review_body:
I used to highly trust Shein and other online shopping platforms, but honestly, over the last two months, not so much. They are engaging in sketchy practices—or maybe their customer support is just completely irresponsible. Either way, I would advise all users to be extremely careful before making any payments on Shein, specifically Shein US.

Here is what happened:
On June 10, 2026, I placed an order for a total of $496.49 USD. Days passed, and I noticed the order was still marked as "pending payment," and I couldn't even see all the items from my purchase. I contacted support to ask what was going on, and they told me I had to contact my bank because they had no record of any payment related to that order. Even though I sent them proof of payment, they kept insisting they hadn't received anything. I contacted my bank, and they confirmed the payment went through successfully; I could also see it marked as "completed" in my banking app.

I went back to Shein support, and this time they told me I should open a dispute/chargeback with my bank since they hadn't received the money. Once I filed the dispute, support suddenly changed their story and said they did see the payment and that it was linked to my order. I told them that was fine and to please just process what I ordered. After some time, they asked me to confirm the payment by uploading the receipt through a link. I did this about 5 times until they finally told me the payment was confirmed.

However, a few days later, I saw the purchase was still pending. I contacted Shein support again, and now they claim that because the payment is under dispute, they cannot process my order. Mind you, it was their own support team that told me to open the dispute in the first place because they claimed they didn't have the money! Now they refuse to process it because of the dispute.

Frustrated but still trying to cooperate, I contacted my bank to cancel the dispute. I was furious, but I honestly thought Shein was trustworthy and wouldn't engage in these kinds of dirty tactics. $496 might be a lot to me, but it's nothing to a massive company like Shein. I didn't think they would ruin their reputation over this amount. They have millions of customers, so losing one means nothing to them, which is exactly why I am leaving this review here—so the rest of you can be aware of this practice.

To make matters worse, every time I contact support now, it feels like they've flagged me as spam. They keep sending automated messages even when I'm supposedly talking to a human, acting as if I'm bothering them. Finally, my bank confirmed that the dispute was officially closed. I contacted support and told them the dispute is closed, so they should either proceed with the order or refund my money. They keep denying it, claiming the dispute is still open. To this day, they tell me the same thing: no refund, no products.

If anyone knows what else I can do so I don't lose my money, I would truly appreciate your help. About 5 days ago, they asked for proof that the dispute was closed. I sent it, and they told me to wait 3 days for their system to update so they could proceed with the refund. Today, they changed their story again, saying it's still open. I honestly don't know what else to do. I am going to keep posting on social media comments to see if anyone else has gone through this and can help me, please.

SHEIN uses a courier that fabricates delivery data and then uses a legal bot to ignore your request for a refund. I placed an order that was promised for delivery and SHEIN used a third-party courier called SpeedX that systematically falsified the tracking updates. Every morning at 6 AM they send automated alerts claiming a "failed delivery attempt" due to a "wrong address" or "no access." They also tried to claim that nobody was home to accept the package. This is completely false, and the package does not require any type of signature to be delivered. My address is correctly entered inside my profile and perfectly matches my billing. There are no gates, bars, or barriers blocking access to my property, and packages are explicitly instructed to be left on the front porch.When you try to contact SHEIN customer service, an agent named Issa tries to pass the merchant responsibilities onto this third-party courier. SpeedX has no direct customer phone line and their own policy states they do not accept recipient claims. When you try to escalate the matter to SHEIN Legal and their executive team, they route you directly to an automated email bot that repeatedly copies and pastes the exact same generic links to keep you trapped in a customer service loop.They continuously shift the delivery windows to stall while holding your funds. Today was the last day for them to deliver and what they did was extended it to an additional day and they are going to keep trying to push it out. They even tried to say one of the reasons for the failure might be an incorrect address which is false and Issa refuses to refund my money. I have been getting the runaround with SpeedX and people named Julia and Kathy are all emailing but they are all trying to give the runaround.This is a violation of consumer protection laws, including the FTC Mail Order Rule and Unfair and Deceptive Trade Practices Acts. They accept your payment and then cut off all human communication so they do not have to issue a refund. Do not trust this company if your package goes missing because their entire support system is a deceptive. After five years of loyal patronage, I will no longer do business with SHEIN and am immediately initiating a merchant dispute through my financial institution. I possess comprehensive documentation, including chat logs where a customer representative admitted that couriers routinely trigger false system alerts whenever processing high-volume loads. review_headline: SHEIN replied to my Trustpilot review…

This is completely unacceptable.

Five items were NOT inside the package when I opened it. They did not fall out, they were not misplaced, and I have already checked everything multiple times.

Instead of providing evidence or offering a real solution, SHEIN simply repeated that their warehouse says everything was shipped, which does not prove that I actually received those items.

So please don’t tell me this case is “being resolved.” It has already been answered, and the answer was to deny my claim without solving anything.

I have already opened a dispute with my bank for the missing items and I will also file a complaint with the consumer protection authorities. I will continue updating this review until this issue is resolved properly.

This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. Buyers should know that if items are missing from their package, SHEIN may simply claim that everything was shipped and leave you without a refund or replacement.

Experiencia absolutamente frustrante con los repartidores que escoge shein

Estoy profundamente cansada, hastiada y frustrada, y también muy enfadada con el servicio de reparto de Ecoscooting y, concretamente, con la repartidora que se encarga habitualmente de mis envíos.

Soy cliente de SHEIN, vivo en Murcia (Número de envío: 300060000107270921) y, en esta ocasión, la repartidora acudió a mi domicilio aproximadamente a las 14:00 horas. Vivo en un segundo piso, no en un undécimo, y esta repartidora busca sistemáticamente excusas para no subir los paquetes hasta mi domicilio: que si lleva prisa, que si no puede dejar el monopatín fuera, que si podrían sustraerle las cosas… Excusas que, sinceramente, considero inaceptables. El monopatín podría dejarse perfectamente dentro del portal, cerrando la puerta, y subir el paquete como corresponde.

Yo no pago un servicio de entrega para tener que bajar a la calle a recoger mis pedidos. Si el envío contratado es una entrega a domicilio, lo lógico es que el paquete se entregue en el domicilio indicado.

Lo que resulta todavía más grave es que, en esta ocasión, el seguimiento indica que no se me ha podido localizar. Eso es sencillamente falso. La repartidora sí me ha localizado y sí ha tenido contacto conmigo. El problema es que, una vez más, no ha querido subir el paquete a mi domicilio. Por tanto, considero especialmente grave que se registre ante la empresa un supuesto intento de entrega que no se corresponde con lo sucedido.

Además, soy una persona con discapacidad y se lo he comunicado expresamente a la repartidora. A pesar de ello, su actitud no ha cambiado lo más mínimo. No le estoy pidiendo ningún trato de favor: estoy pidiendo que se realice correctamente un servicio de entrega a domicilio.

Y, para terminar de empeorar la situación, su trato personal ha sido francamente desagradable. En una de las ocasiones me dejó con la palabra en la boca y se marchó sin siquiera despedirse.

Creo que Ecoscooting debería revisar seriamente lo que está ocurriendo con determinadas personas de su servicio de reparto, porque este tipo de actuaciones no solo perjudican al destinatario: también perjudican directamente a las empresas con las que trabajan.

En este caso, mi pedido procede de SHEIN, y considero importante que SHEIN conozca también el problema. Cuando una empresa de comercio electrónico confía sus entregas a una compañía de transporte, la experiencia del cliente con esa compañía de reparto termina repercutiendo directamente sobre la imagen de la propia tienda.

Espero que Ecoscooting revise este caso, compruebe el historial de entregas y las incidencias registradas y, sobre todo, tome medidas para que no vuelva a repetirse. No es razonable que un cliente tenga que discutir cada vez para conseguir que le entreguen un paquete en la puerta de su propia casa.

review_headline: 🚨 WARNING: TERRIBLE SHEIN CUSTOMER SERVICE — 5 ITEMS MISSING FROM MY ORDER
review_body:
🚨 WARNING: TERRIBLE SHEIN CUSTOMER SERVICE — FIVE ITEMS MISSING FROM MY ORDER

I am beyond angry and disappointed with SHEIN right now.

I placed a large back-to-school order with clothing and other items. When my package arrived, it was covered in a ridiculous amount of tape and looked like it had been opened, damaged, and then retaped during shipping. That alone was concerning.

Then I opened the package and discovered that FIVE ITEMS WERE MISSING.

I immediately contacted SHEIN customer service to report the missing items. You would think a company would at least investigate the situation, especially when the package arrived looking like it had clearly been tampered with or damaged.

Instead, customer service basically told me, “We shipped everything, so there’s nothing we can do.”

Seriously?!

So I’m just supposed to pay for five items I NEVER RECEIVED? I have the damaged-looking, heavily taped package as evidence, I have my order information, and I have five missing items — yet SHEIN refuses to refund me or send the items that I actually PAID FOR.

I order from SHEIN all the time, and this is how they choose to treat a repeat customer? Absolutely unacceptable.

I understand that something could have happened during transit. That is exactly why I contacted SHEIN in the first place. But instead of helping me resolve the problem, they essentially washed their hands of it and left me stuck with the loss.

review_headline: Beschadigd pakket, ontbrekende artikelen en geen oplossing
review_body:
Ik bestel al jaren bij SHEIN en was altijd tevreden, maar de laatste tijd gaat het steeds vaker mis. Waar je vroeger een tijdvak kreeg voor de bezorging, moet je nu de hele dag thuis blijven omdat er geen indicatie meer wordt gegeven van wanneer je pakket wordt geleverd. Dat is ontzettend onhandig.
Mijn laatste bestelling was echter de druppel. Deze werd verdeeld over meerdere verzendzakken geleverd. In iedere zak zat wel ergens een scheur of gaatje, maar één van de zakken had een enorme scheur. Volgens de app hadden hierin vier kledingstukken moeten zitten, maar er zaten er slechts twee in. De twee missende rokjes zaten ook niet in de andere verzendzakken. Op 28-08 heb ik direct foto's gestuurd en een klacht ingediend bij de klantenservice. Inmiddels zijn we zes dagen verder en krijg ik telkens pas na ongeveer 24 uur een reactie. Iedere keer krijg ik hetzelfde standaardantwoord: dat volgens hun controle alle artikelen correct zijn verzonden en dat het gewicht klopt. Ik heb meerdere malen uitgelegd dat ik niet beweer dat SHEIN de artikelen niet heeft verzonden. Het probleem is juist dat de verzendzak zwaar beschadigd was en dat de kledingstukken waarschijnlijk tijdens transport zijn verdwenen of zijn weggenomen. Toch blijft de klantenservice dezelfde standaard reactie sturen, steeds door een andere medewerker, zonder daadwerkelijk naar de situatie te kijken. Inmiddels wacht ik zelfs al meer dan 30 uur op de volgende reactie. Er wordt totaal niet meegedacht en er wordt geen passende oplossing aangeboden.
Ik ga absoluut niet betalen voor artikelen die ik nooit heb ontvangen. Na jarenlang klant te zijn geweest is dit een enorme teleurstelling. Slechte bezorging, slechte klantenservice en geen enkele verantwoordelijkheid voor een duidelijk transportprobleem. Helaas is dit voor mij echt een 1-ster ervaring.

review_headline: Nog steeds niet geholpen door SHEIN
review_body:
Mijn retourzending JVGL06363139001771800748 is volgens DHL op 24 juli om 11:00 uur bij SHEIN afgeleverd. In deze doos zaten artikelen uit de volgende bestellingen:

GSO17D54U000JWH, GSO17D54U000JWJ, GSO17D54U001VPB, GSO17D54U001VPA, GSO17V54N0035NJ, GSO17V54N0035NH, GSO17V54N00T2BG, GSO17V54N00T2BL en GSO17V54N003DCJ.

Op 8 augustus heeft medewerker DOM mijn zaak doorgestuurd voor verificatie en zou dit ongeveer 3 werkdagen duren maar ik heb niks meer gehoord. Na mijn eerdere review nam SHEIN op 19 augustus opnieuw contact met mij op. Ik heb de volgende dag 20 aug alle gevraagde informatie en bewijzen gestuurd, maar daarna hoor ik niets meer.

Ook via de chat krijg ik alleen automatische antwoorden en telefonisch word ik telkens opgehanden. Er is zelfs ongevraagd een nieuw retourlabel aangemaakt door de medewerker van de chat: JVGL06363139000470647543.

Ik vraag alleen dat SHEIN mijn daadwerkelijk afgeleverde pakket intern traceert, controleert welke artikelen zijn ontvangen en mijn retour correct verwerkt. Alle informatie is inmiddels verstrekt.

Krijg heel vaak bestellingen waarbij de verpakkingsmateriaal defect/ingedeukt/gescheurd zijn. Het is een structureel probleem! Dit heb ik altijd geaccepteerd geen melding van gemaakt zolang het artikel zelf niet beschadigd zijn. Daarnaast zijn al die jaren retouren goed verwerkt met een defect verpakking!

Zo heb ik in juni 2026 twee schoenen retour gestuurd waarbij maar liefst € 16,57 is ingehouden aan herstelkosten voor defecte producten. Als bewijs hebben zij de ingedeukte schoenendozen laten zien. De verpakking is toch niet het product zelf?

Voor alle duidelijkheid was zoals gewoonlijk de verpakking ingedeukt/gescheurd. Ik heb de artikelen niet gebruikt of de verpakking geopend op een manier dat schade zou veroorzaken. Very disappointing experience with SHEIN.

On 24 May 2026, I placed orders worth CZK 4,687. One dress worth CZK 499 was missing from the original parcel. SHEIN rejected my claim, so I returned the remaining 9 items within the 14-day return period.

The parcel was delivered to SHEIN on 10 June 2026 and, according to SHEIN's own records, received at their warehouse on 17 June 2026.

Despite this, I am still waiting for my refund. SHEIN keeps referring me to a "payment platform" and giving me different explanations and deadlines.

They now claim that CZK 559 has been refunded to my card, but I have not received it. I am still waiting for approximately CZK 3,800 for the other 8 returned items.

After months of unsuccessful communication, I have contacted the European Consumer Centre for help.

I have never experienced such a frustrating refund process. I will not shop with SHEIN again.

UPDATE – 4 September 2026

Following my review, I received a response from SHEIN on 3 September 2026 stating that the refund for order GSO1YE24500N8GH would be processed within 24 hours.

Unfortunately, even after this deadline has passed, I have still not received the refund. I have also received no response to my repeated requests for the ARN or other confirmation that the refund was actually processed.

The situation regarding order GSO1YE24500N8GV is even more difficult to understand. SHEIN repeatedly states that the “relevant department is verifying and processing the case”. However, this case has now been “verified and processed” for 85 days. The goods were properly returned and SHEIN has confirmed that they were received.

How long can a “relevant department” continue verifying and processing something that was resolved 85 days ago? If the case is simply being passed from one department to another, it raises serious questions about how SHEIN’s refund system actually works.

I have already provided all the necessary information and proof of the return and receipt of the goods.

After 85 days, I still do not have my money. Instead of a concrete solution, I continue to receive explanations, referrals to different departments and requests for patience.

This is no longer a matter of patience or an ordinary delay. SHEIN is failing to comply with its own terms and its legal obligations regarding refunds for goods that have been properly returned.

Helt forferdelig retursystem og kundeservice!

Jeg har aldri opplevd et så dårlig retursystem.

Jeg tok kontakt med SHEIN kun to dager etter at pakken ble mottatt, og returen min ble godkjent 1. juli. Allerede 2. juli sendte jeg pakken tilbake til SHEIN, til returadressen de selv oppga. Jeg betalte hele returkostnaden på ca. 350 NOK selv, til tross for at SHEIN reklamerer med gratis retur.

Pakken ankom Polen og ble forsøkt levert til SHEIN 14. august. SHEIN nektet imidlertid å ta imot pakken, og kansellerte deretter returforespørselen min gjennom Klarna.

Siden dette har jeg vært fanget i en runddans mellom SHEIN og Klarna, uten at noen tar ansvar eller faktisk hjelper meg. Jeg har kontaktet SHEINs kundeservice flere ganger, og hver gang får jeg en ny forklaring på hvorfor de mener at returen ikke kan godkjennes.

Det siste de nå hevder, er at jeg ikke returnerte pakken innenfor deres «30 days policy». Dette er helt uforståelig, ettersom jeg har dokumentasjon på hele prosessen: kommunikasjonen med SHEIN, kommunikasjonen med Klarna, godkjenningen av returen og sporingen som tydelig viser når pakken ble sendt og når den ankom Polen.

Jeg gjorde nøyaktig det SHEIN ba meg om å gjøre, brukte returadressen de oppga og betalte selv for returforsendelsen. Likevel nekter de å ta imot pakken og prøver nå å legge ansvaret over på meg.

Helt forferdelig service og et utrolig frustrerende system. Jeg kommer aldri til å handle hos SHEIN igjen, og anbefaler andre å være svært forsiktige dersom de skulle få behov for å returnere en vare.

REDIGERT: Det var først etter denne anmeldelsen Shein tok ansvar for bestillingen, etter å ha kranglet frem og tilbake siden Juni.

review_headline: SHEIN det er sidste gang jeg handler…
review_body:
SHEIN det er sidste gang jeg handler hos jer!

Jeg er simpelthen så frustreret og vred over den måde, SHEIN håndterer returneringer på. Jeg har sendt en kæmpe returpakke med ca 15-16 varer, men SHEIN påstår, at de kun har modtaget 10. Det betyder, at jeg nu bliver bedt om at betale lidt over 300 kr. for varer, som jeg rent faktisk har sendt retur!

Jeg handlede gennem Klarna netop fordi jeg vidste, at jeg skulle returnere en del. Jeg havde blandt andet bestilt 2 stk. af flere sæt, så jeg kunne prøve dem og være sikker på størrelse og pasform. Alt blev pakket og sendt retur samlet.

Jeg kontaktede SHEIN, og de siger, at jeg skal kontakte Klarna. Jeg kontakter Klarna, som faktisk hjælper mig, opretter en refundering og sætter betalingen på pause, mens de afventer svar fra SHEIN.

Og så kommer SHEIN tilbage og AFVISER refunderingen og ændringen af betalingen.

Så nu står jeg som kunde og skal betale lidt over 300 kr. for noget, jeg allerede har returneret. Hvordan kan det være mit problem, hvis SHEIN ikke har styr på deres eget retursystem?!

Og det er ikke engang første gang. Tidligere manglede der én T-shirt til omkring 70 kr. i en pakke jeg havde modtaget. Jeg kontaktede dem af flere omgange, bedt dem om at sende den røde tshirt, men SHEIN valgte simpelthen ikke at tro på mig, så jeg måtte betale for den🖕🏻

Det er simpelthen ikke i orden. Jeg kan godt forstå, at der kan ske fejl, men når fejlene konsekvent ender med at koste kunden penge, og kundeservice samtidig bare sender én frem og tilbage mellem SHEIN og Klarna, så er det helt håbløst.

Jeg har handlet hos SHEIN flere gange, og det har tidligere fungeret fint, men efter det her har jeg fået nok.

Jeg gider ikke bruge min tid på at kæmpe med SHEIN om penge for varer, jeg allerede har returneret.

Hvis I handler hos SHEIN, så gem ALT: billeder af pakken, indholdet, kvittering, tracking, indleveringsbevis – alt. For hvis deres system ikke registrerer det hele, kan det åbenbart blive dig, der skal betale.

SHEIN, få styr på jeres returhåndtering og jeres kundeservice. Det her er simpelthen ikke acceptabelt.

Det er sidste gang, jeg handler hos jer. 👎

review_headline: Shein ist Betrug! Keine Rückserstattung von retouren
review_body:
Shein ist Betrug!
Ich habe dort eine Bestellung aufgegeben.
Es kamen dann zwei Pakete mit erheblicher Verzögerung zueinander. Für die erste Lieferung habe ich einen Retoure Schein bekommen und die Ware zurück geschickt, eine Erstattung habe ich nicht erhalten! Paypal hilft in diesem Fall nicht da es sich um einen Wiederruf handelt. Der Shein Chat verweist auf die Servicenummer, diese ist immer besetzt und legt dann auf. Das Geld ist nur über einen Anwalt ein zu klagen laut Paypal.
Für die zweite Lieferung wurde ein Retoure Schien abgelehnt daher möchte ich auf eigene Kosten zurück senden. Nachdem ich dies angeboten habe kommen nur noch automatische E -Mails das der Fall abgeschlossen ist. Mir wird keine Adresse für die Rücksendung aufgegeben. Eine Rechnung habe ich viele Male angefordert da die Bestellung im Kundenkonto plötzlich verschwunden ist. Ich wurde von Shein um 114,08 EUR betrogen. Shein hat ein System das Beschwerden einfach abweist und Paypal fülht sich bei Wiederrufen und Lieferungen bei denen die Größe abweicht nicht zuständig. Ich empfehle daher auf keinen Fall bei Shein zu bestellen da Sie schlichtweg betrogen werden. Paypal lässt einen als Kunden ebenfalls "im Regen stehen" daher ist die Bezahlung über diese Plattform schlichtweg keine Sicherheit!
Plus jamais ça !

review_headline: SHEIN: Very disappointing customer service… NO RETURN ALLOWED
review_body:
Very disappointing customer service experience of SHEIN.

I wanted to return a few dresses that were completely unworn, still in their original packaging, and with all tags attached. Unfortunately, I missed the return request deadline by just one day.

Despite this, I contacted customer service hoping they would show some flexibility. Instead, I was asked to take and send multiple photos of the items, and later even provide pictures of the dresses next to a measuring tape. After complying with all these requests, I received a very brief response stating that a return was simply not possible.

What disappointed me most was not the refusal itself, but the complete lack of willingness to find a compromise or offer any customer-friendly solution. After spending time gathering all the requested information, I expected at least some consideration of the circumstances.

Being refused over a delay of just one day for brand-new, unworn items feels unreasonable and unnecessarily rigid. In my experience, other retailers are far more understanding and customer-oriented in similar situations.

Unfortunately, this experience has left me with the impression that SHEIN prioritizes strict policies over customer satisfaction. I genuinely regret how this situation was handled.

***** UPDATE UPON REACTION SHEIN*****

I have checked my email and, unfortunately, the "solution" provided was simply a confirmation that no return would be accepted.

My concern is that despite providing all requested photos and information, no alternative or goodwill gesture was considered for a delay of only one day on brand-new, unworn items.

This experience has reinforced my impression that customer satisfaction is secondary to rigid policy enforcement.

review_headline: I have been a longtime SHEIN customer…
review_body:
I have been a longtime SHEIN customer (easily over a decade buying from them) but this experience has completely changed how I feel about ordering from them.

My shipment was supposed to contain 14 individual pieces across 11 line items. I received only 4 pieces. TEN pieces were missing from the package. This package was for my 7th grade daughters back to school shopping. 

I spent hours contacting SHEIN customer service trying to resolve what should have been a straightforward fulfillment issue. I repeatedly offered very reasonable solutions: reship the missing merchandise OR provide approximately $59 in SHEIN store credit so I could reorder my daughter’s missing back-to-school clothes. I wasn’t even insisting on a refund to my original payment method. SHEIN repeatedly refused.

Their explanation was simply that their warehouse “investigation” or “verification” showed everything had been shipped. I repeatedly asked what that investigation actually consisted of and requested escalation/supervisor information, but I was not provided any meaningful information or evidence demonstrating that all 14 pieces were actually contained in the package delivered to me.

I have the carrier’s proof-of-delivery photograph showing the package that was delivered, as well as a photograph of the 4 pieces I actually received.

After spending hours unsuccessfully trying to resolve this directly with SHEIN, I finally opened a dispute with PayPal. Only after I filed the payment dispute did SHEIN tell me they would like to resolve the situation but that I should withdraw my PayPal dispute first and then wait for the payment platform’s processing period before SHEIN could address it.

This isn’t about $59 anymore. It’s about the principle of paying for merchandise, not receiving it, and then having virtually no meaningful recourse when the retailer’s warehouse records say otherwise.

Mistakes happen. The way a company handles the mistake is what defines its customer service. Unfortunately, SHEIN’s handling of order GSU1RQ091001UUA has been incredibly disappointing and frustrating.

review_headline: ⭐ **1 estrella Primera y última vez que compro en SHEIN
review_body:
⭐ **1 estrella – Primera y última vez que compro en SHEIN**

Mi primera experiencia comprando en SHEIN está siendo **malísima** y, desde luego, será también la última.

Tengo el pedido **completamente pagado** y SHEIN ya tiene el dinero. Aun así, me están pidiendo una y otra vez **información de verificación del movimiento bancario**, es decir, el justificante donde aparece claramente el pago realizado.

He enviado esa documentación **cinco o seis veces** y no hay manera de que me la validen. Me la siguen rechazando continuamente, pero sin explicarme de forma clara qué es exactamente lo que falta o qué necesitan que envíe diferente.

Lo más frustrante es que **el dinero ya está en su poder**, pero mantienen el pedido bloqueado y no me dan ninguna solución real. Además, se trata de un regalo que necesito recibir, por lo que toda esta situación me está causando muchísima frustración.

He intentado solucionarlo repetidamente y sigo exactamente igual: **pago realizado, movimiento bancario enviado varias veces y pedido parado**.

Para ser mi primera compra, la experiencia no puede haber sido peor. **No volveré a comprar en SHEIN.** Esta forma de gestionar un problema genera una inseguridad enorme como cliente.

Solo pido algo tan sencillo como que revisen correctamente la documentación, tramiten el pedido o, si no son capaces de solucionarlo, que **me devuelvan el dinero inmediatamente**.
Facile, veloce e puntuale

Ze vraagt me nota bene om "in de vouwen van de doos" te kijken. Denken jullie serieus dat kledingstukken in de vouwen van een doos verdwijnen? Er is een verkeerd artikel ingepakt, dus jullie gewichtsregistratie klopt sowieso van geen kant!Ik pikt dit niet. Ik wil per direct mijn geld terug voor de missende artikelen. Als dit niet binnen 48 uur wordt opgelost, gaat mijn officiële klacht naar het Europees Consumenten Centrum (ECC).

review_headline: Unusable website—the non-stop pop-ups drove me away!!

Unusable website—the non-stop pop-ups drove me away!


Review:
I went onto the website to shop for summer holiday clothes, but I could only stand being on there for about 5 minutes before I had to leave. 
A recommendation pop-up appeared approximately every two seconds asking if I wanted to look at similar items or if I was interested in other products.
Having to constantly click again and again and AGAIN just to clear the pop-up to continue to browse was incredibly infuriating. 

It completely ruins the shopping experience. Don't you realise that this aggressive setup completely drives people away? I have taken my business elsewhere to websites that actually let me browse in peace. Absolutely awful website.


Additional information (added 25th August 2026)

Note for Trustpilot: 

This review is an honest appraisal of my user experience regarding the aggressive pop-up design on the public website interface, which directly disrupted my browsing. 

As this complaint concerns website functionality and user design rather than a finalised transaction, a customer order reference number does not exist.

review_headline: Dernière commande chez SHEIN – pratiques que je considère comme malhonnêtes
review_body:
Ce sera définitivement mon dernier achat chez SHEIN.

J’ai retourné deux articles simplement essayés, immédiatement remis dans leurs emballages et absolument pas détériorés. SHEIN devait me rembourser 41,53 €. À ma grande surprise, je n’ai reçu que 4,15 € !

SHEIN a retenu 37,38 €, soit environ 90 % de la valeur des articles, sous prétexte de « frais de restauration pour produits défectueux ».

J’ai demandé les photos et les preuves des prétendues détériorations justifiant une telle retenue. Je conteste catégoriquement avoir endommagé ces articles.

Je trouve cette manière de procéder profondément malhonnête. Avec les nouvelles contraintes et les coûts liés à l’importation des produits en Europe, je ne peux m’empêcher de m’interroger sur ces retenues massives appliquées aux remboursements. Je ne peux évidemment pas affirmer qu’il existe un lien, mais cette expérience m’inspire une méfiance totale.

J’ai effectué un signalement sur SignalConso et je poursuivrai ma contestation tant qu’une preuve réelle des prétendus dommages ne m’aura pas été fournie.

Après de nombreuses commandes, SHEIN vient de perdre définitivement une cliente. Je ne commanderai plus sur cette plateforme et je conseille vivement à toute personne effectuant un retour de photographier et filmer chaque article avant de fermer son colis.

Pour moi, c’est terminé.

Sinds begin juli ben ik bezig om een probleem met meerdere retourartikelen opgelost te krijgen. Ondanks meerdere mails krijg ik geen duidelijke en inhoudelijke antwoorden op mijn vragen. Ik heb meerdere keren gevraagd om per artikel afzonderlijk uit te leggen waarom er geen terugbetaling of correctie plaatsvindt, maar daar wordt nog steeds niet inhoudelijk op gereageerd.

De betreffende artikelen zijn bovendien nog steeds in het bezit van het bedrijf. Toch krijg ik telkens wisselende argumenten en blijf ik ondertussen zelf met de financiële gevolgen zitten. Vandaag heb ik opnieuw aan Klarna moeten betalen omdat de betalingstermijn is verstreken.

Wat ik bijzonder teleurstellend vind, is dat er op Trustpilot snel wordt gereageerd met de indruk dat de klacht wordt opgepakt. In de praktijk blijkt daar vervolgens weinig van. Ik neem daarom geen genoegen meer met alleen een reactie op mijn Trustpilot-review. Ik verwacht daadwerkelijk contact, duidelijke antwoorden en vooral een concrete oplossing.

Fouten kunnen worden gemaakt, maar het is niet redelijk dat de klant daar wekenlang de dupe van wordt. Na inmiddels ruim anderhalve maand verwacht ik simpelweg dat deze kwestie serieus wordt behandeld en eindelijk correct wordt opgelost.

Mijn ervaring tot nu toe: veel beloftes, maar geen daadwerkelijke oplossing.

review_headline: It is shocking to see how Shein operates
review_body:
I purchased and paid for items during the loyalty promotion periode. Now they claim the items are out of stock, and their system is forcing a cancellation instead of just letting me wait for them to come back in stock.

It really seems like Shein is speculating in this. They are exploiting a temporary warehouse error as an easy shortcut to delete my cheap order, so they can force me to buy the exact same items at full price later.

Since Shein actively targets EU consumers they are legally required to comply with the danish Sale of Goods Act, and EU consumer rules. An agreement is BINDING, and you cannot just cancel a paid order to get out of a given discount.

If they were honest, they would put my order on hold until new items were packed. Instead, they deliberately break the consumer law and rush to cancel.

In the chat, employees sit and tell lies about the order not being deleted, while allready 3 items has been deleted without my concent and the system counts down to whole anullment in the background.

Then someone told me i could open a ticket, which I  did and had an absolutely absurd conversation with SHEIN. I say “absurd” because none of the responses I have received actually address my problem. The answers seem completely disconnected from what I telling and completely out of context. At this point, I honestly believe I am dealing with robot responses to a completely different  issue rather than someone actually responding to my specific case. It is so Kafkaesque!

The fact is, shein have set the items to be deleted tomorrow, the mails I recived from shein say that and the platform showing that throgh a big trash can symbol splashed over all the items. When SHEIN completely ignores THAT,  they REALLY do not want to dolve this problem. They could as well have ignored me.



IF SHEIN contuines not to stop the anullment, I demand that a real employee takes responsibility and gives me a personal discount code covering the price difference per item, so I can reorder at my original price when the items land back in stock.
As said before, this is not legal and i will take it all the way to EU consumer centre, if shein does not apply to the law.

review_headline: Deceptive Order Cancellation: SHEIN refuses to honor its own written refund policy
review_body:
I purchased a pair of shoes on sale for €5 using 600 points. SHEIN suddenly canceled my order claiming the item was 'out of stock.' However, the seller immediately kept the exact same shoes live on the app for €25—forcing a €20 price increase on an item I had already paid for.
​To make matters worse, this wrongful cancellation caused my 600 points (€6 value) to expire without reinstatement. It feels like a bait-and-switch tactic to force me to re-buy the item at full price. Customer support agents (Felix, Queen, Alina, Leo, Konrad, Harvy,.. ) refused to address the price jump or transfer me to a manager. I am requesting a €26 Wallet Credit to cover the price difference and lost points caused by SHEIN's cancellation error. I kept talking through the ticket and costumer support system and they only send generic copy paste responds about having reviewed my case and being unable to compensate me. They even oftenly send responds that didnt even answer my questions making it apparent that they were copy and paste generic responds.

UPDATE (17.August): 
A senior representative named Natalia intervened, she initially offered a lowball 400 points (~4$)—which is less than the 600 points SHEIN's error cost me in the first place. 

​When I rejected that offer, she claimed the "maximum compensation" SHEIN could offer was a 15% coupon. The math behind this is completely insulting: a 15% coupon on a €25 item saves a mere €3.75, forcing me to pay €21.25 out of pocket for shoes I already bought for €5.

​SHEIN uses system cancellations to push bait-and-switch pricing, forces customers to pay more money to replace canceled items, and refuses to restore lost point balances. I am demanding a manager grant full restoration of my 600 points plus a €20 Wallet Credit to resolve this ticket.

​UPDATE 2 (18.August): The senior representative stopped texting me, instead agent Frank officially confirmed SHEIN's policy in writing, stating: "If the points which you used at the time of purchasing the order get expired, then they will be filled up with the current points." He says that is the reason they can't refund me my points, but my case follows exactly the policy he mentions, which shows SHEIN is just saying that they reviewed what happened while having not. 

​I used 600 points on this order, which SHEIN canceled. They refunded the points with an absurd 48-hour expiration window while I was trapped in support chats and waiting for their reply, letting them expire on 13.08. Despite Frank admitting their own policy requires replacing these points, SHEIN is STILL refusing to deposit my 600 active points and is continuing to push a 15% coupon

Final Update (27.August): Finally, after days of complaints and talking to SHEIN's customer service, I was provided with some compensation (a 15% coupon, €6 credit/points, and a free shipping coupon). I personally wished for more because this doesn't cover the difference in price for the shoes I initially wanted, but the agents insisted for days that they couldn't give me more.

Har fine og rimelige ting og klær. Grunnen til jeg gir dem ikke full stjerner er fordi man må selv betale for returfakten og det lønner seg ikke. Desverre blir ikke shein en plass jeg kommer til å handle fremtidig på da det blir dyrt å returnere varer som er billigere enn frakten../ med andre ord du går i minus.

BETRUG!!!*  
9,77€ Bestellung →  Einiger  Tage später buchen sie einfach 9,28€ extra ab!!!  
Ohne Erlaubnis! Ohne Grund!  
Karte sperren müssen. 2 Wochen kein Geld für 5 Kinder.  
SHEIN klaut Geld. Finger weg!

review_headline: Unresolved Intellectual Property Dispute and Lack of Communication
review_body:
I am submitting this complaint regarding an unresolved intellectual property dispute with SHEIN concerning the unauthorised commercial use of my personal images on its platform.

I discovered that SHEIN was displaying and using images of me without my knowledge or consent in connection with product listings used to advertise and sell clothing. I first contacted SHEIN on 4 April 2025 and have since made numerous attempts to resolve the matter, providing the requested evidence and documentation to multiple SHEIN departments.

After months of unsuccessful attempts, the matter was escalated to Kevin McPherson, SHEIN’s Senior IP Counsel, who contacted me regarding the dispute and indicated that he was investigating the matter. We subsequently exchanged correspondence regarding a potential amicable resolution, including settlement discussions.

Despite continuing to engage in good faith, communication has once again stalled. My most recent response to Mr. McPherson was sent on 5 June 2026, and I have received no response since.

I simply want to bring this matter to a reasonable conclusion. However, it has become increasingly difficult to do so when months can pass without a response despite my continued attempts to communicate. At this rate, this dispute could enter its second year without resolution.

I am therefore asking SHEIN to resume substantive communication, assign an appropriate representative to handle the matter, and make a genuine effort to resolve this longstanding dispute amicably.

review_headline: I have been a SHEIN customer
review_body:
I have been a SHEIN customer, but after this experience, I will seriously reconsider ever ordering from them again. SHEIN needs to STOP using GOFO as a delivery company.

My package was supposed to be delivered today. My building requires access after hours, and my delivery instructions clearly state that I should be contacted if the driver needs access. I kept my phone with me specifically for this reason. The GOFO driver arrived after hours, could not access the building, and never even attempted to call me. Now I don’t have my package.

And apparently, this is not just a one time incident. GOFO’s Google reviews are terrible, with many customers complaining about their delivery experiences. When a delivery company has this kind of reputation, SHEIN should be paying attention.

I understand that SHEIN doesn’t personally deliver the packages, but SHEIN chooses the companies they trust with their customers’ orders. When that delivery company provides terrible service, it ultimately reflects on SHEIN.

Customers spend their money with SHEIN and should be able to expect reliable delivery and basic communication. Until SHEIN stops using GOFO or gives customers the option to choose a more reliable carrier, I will not be shopping with SHEIN again. It’s ridiculous to lose loyal customers over a delivery company with such poor customer service.

review_headline: 5,44 € : même pour une réclamation sérieuse, SHEIN préfère un robot au client
review_body:
Nouvelle expérience désastreuse avec le service client SHEIN.

J’ai acheté fin juin une paire de sandales à 5,44 €. Après seulement 2 ou 3 tentatives de les porter, j’ai constaté que la matière me provoquait de véritables sensations de brûlure, avec rougeurs et irritations. Au départ, j’ai pensé que la matière allait simplement se détendre avec le temps. Ce n’est absolument pas le cas.

J’ai donc contacté le service client et passé plus de 25 minutes en chat avec une conseillère, Douja. Je lui ai expliqué précisément le problème et lui ai transmis des photos. Elle avait parfaitement identifié la commande et sa date, et je lui ai clairement précisé que les sandales avaient déjà été portées. Elle m’a proposé de procéder au retour et m’a indiqué que le fait qu’elles aient été portées ne posait pas de problème. Elle devait simplement m’envoyer l’étiquette de retour.

Et là, changement radical : sans aucune explication, je reçois soudainement un message robotique m’indiquant que le délai de 30 jours est dépassé et qu’aucun défaut n’a été détecté !

Donc plus de 25 minutes d’échange, des explications détaillées, des photos, une conseillère qui accepte le principe du retour… puis un robot qui annule tout sans même répondre au problème signalé.

Et tout cela pour une paire de sandales à 5,44 € !

Le montant est dérisoire, mais le problème est sérieux : une matière qui provoque brûlures, rougeurs et irritations après quelques utilisations mérite au minimum un véritable examen, pas une réponse automatique.

SHEIN, si même lorsqu’un client signale un problème potentiellement lié au matériau d’un produit, votre service client se contente de réponses automatisées et contradictoires, il y a clairement un problème de prise en charge.

Encore une expérience qui ne donne vraiment pas envie de faire confiance à votre service client.

In Vancouver, returning through Canada Post was effortless. In Toronto, SHEIN uses a third-party shipper that has been a nightmare—multiple trips, locations closed during posted hours, and one operating with handwritten hours taped to the door. It took repeated attempts plus TWO additional trips just to finally return my package.
Then SHEIN issued the wrong refund and claimed TWO items were missing. They were returned. I actually recorded my return, sent SHEIN the VIDEO and asked them to review it. They ignored it. This also happened with my previous order.
Then comes the predictable cycle: generic replies that don't resolve anything, silence, and when you leave a public review: “Send us your details so we can investigate.”
YOU ALREADY HAVE THEM. 50+ EMAILS, PHOTOS, DOCUMENTATION AND VIDEO.
Stop making customers pay for failures occurring within your own quality control and return network. Investigate where these items are going after customers hand them over.

review_headline: Evitare di acquistare su questo sito
review_body: Evitare di acquistare su questo sito. Ti fanno le truffe. Ho pagato per un ordine mai arrivato e non vogliono rimborsarmi. Spero che falliscono.

Ho acquistato su SHEIN tre profumi Armaf. I prodotti ricevuti presentano confezioni differenti da quelle mostrate nelle inserzioni; in uno dei casi mancavano elementi grafici chiaramente visibili nelle immagini pubblicitarie.

Ho inoltre riscontrato anomalie nell’elenco degli ingredienti e non sono riuscita a verificare, attraverso i canali consultati, l’associazione dei codici EAN ai prodotti dichiarati. Non posso affermare con certezza che i prodotti non siano originali, ma queste incongruenze non mi consentono di verificarne l’autenticità e, trattandosi di prodotti da applicare sulla pelle, ritengo la questione particolarmente importante.

Ho segnalato tutto allegando fotografie e richiesto il rimborso (di cui sono in attesa) per prodotti non conformi alla descrizione. Ho anche pubblicato una recensione dettagliata e fattuale sulla piattaforma, ma il testo non è stato approvato, mentre le immagini sì, senza che mi venisse fornita una motivazione specifica.

Seguono i testi non pubblicati dall'azienda ma che sarebbero utili ai consumatori.
Profumo Armaf Club de nuit woman:
"Il prodotto presenta gravi incongruenze rispetto a un articolo originale. La confezione dichiara 50 ml, ma il codice EAN 6085010094151 corrisponde al formato Armaf Club de Nuit Woman da 105 ml. Inoltre, sulla confezione compare l’errore “MADI IN FRANCE”, il nome sulla bottiglia (“women”) non coincide con quello sulla scatola (“woman”) e sulla bottiglia non è presente un codice lotto corrispondente. Per motivi di autenticità e sicurezza chiedo il rimborso completo per prodotto non conforme."
Profumo Armaf Infinity Silver:
"Il prodotto ricevuto non corrisponde alle immagini dell’inserzione: la confezione pubblicizzata presenta due fasce diagonali nere, completamente assenti sulla confezione ricevuta. Inoltre, il codice EAN 6975117009144 non risulta verificabile come codice ufficiale di Armaf Infinity Silver 30 ml e l’elenco degli ingredienti presenta errori e ripetizioni. Il prodotto è ancora sigillato. Chiedo il rimborso completo per articolo non conforme alla descrizione e con autenticità non verificabile."
Profumo Armaf Infinity Blue:
"Il prodotto è ancora sigillato e presenta elementi che non consentono di verificarne l’autenticità. Il codice EAN 6975117009168 non risulta associato in modo attendibile a una versione ufficiale Armaf Infinity Blue 30 ml. Inoltre, questa variante riporta esattamente lo stesso codice lotto, le stesse date e lo stesso elenco ingredienti della variante Infinity Silver acquistata nello stesso ordine, nonostante si tratti di due profumi differenti. L’elenco contiene anche ripetizioni ed errori di denominazione. Chiedo il rimborso completo per articolo non conforme e autenticità non verificabile."

AGGIORNAMENTO:
A seguito della vostra risposta confermo di aver ricevuto la mail con la richiesta delle fotografie delle confezioni (che comunque avevo già allegato, per i dati di interesse, i fase di recensione sul sito Shein). Confermo anche di aver inviato in risposta alla vostra mail, altre tre mail con le foto dei prodotti. 
Il pacco, che come ho anticipato ho reso per ragioni di autenticità e sicurezza, è in transito con corriere FedEx.
Non so a cosa vi riferiate riguardo al qualcosa di già emesso ai fini della soluzione del problema. Grazie per l'attenzione.

review_body:
Jeg er virkelig skuffet over SHEIN. Min pakke har nu været forsinket i over en måned, og jeg har stadig ikke modtaget den. Det værste er næsten kundeservicen, som er fuldstændig ubrugelig.

Jeg har kontaktet kundeservice flere gange, men får enten standardsvar, som ikke hjælper mig overhovedet, eller svar fra medarbejdere, der tydeligvis ikke forstår, hvad jeg skriver. Jeg har forsøgt at forklare situationen igen og igen, men føler seriøst, at jeg taler til en mur.

Det er utrolig frustrerende at have betalt for varer, vente over en måned og samtidig ikke kunne få et ordentligt svar på, hvor ens pakke er, eller hvad der bliver gjort ved problemet.

Jeg havde faktisk glædet mig rigtig meget til de ting, jeg har bestilt, så det er ekstra irriterende at opleve så dårlig service, når der opstår et problem.

SHEIN, I skal virkelig få styr på jeres kundeservice og levering. Det her er simpelthen ikke godt nok.

Ik ben dit inmiddels zat en overweeg serieus om verdere stappen te ondernemen. Ik heb letsel opgelopen en vind het onacceptabel dat ik vervolgens op deze manier word behandeld en niet serieus word genomen.

Ik heb niets aan een tegoed van €20 wanneer ik brandwonden en letsel heb opgelopen. Het hele dossier speelt inmiddels al sinds 25 april. Ik verwacht daarom dat mijn klacht serieus wordt opgepakt en dat er op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie en passende oplossing komt. Shein gaat zo om met slachtoffers. Jullie hebben mij geestelijk ziek gemaakt.

Une expérience qui interroge sérieusement sur le sérieux et l’éthique commerciale de SHEIN.

J’ai commandé une veste. À la place, j’ai reçu… un pantalon. Il ne s’agit pas d’une simple différence de taille ou de couleur, mais d’un article totalement différent de celui acheté. Une erreur aussi importante est difficilement acceptable.

Le plus choquant reste toutefois la gestion du service après-vente. Malgré une erreur qui est exclusivement imputable au vendeur, il m’a été demandé de renvoyer l’article à mes frais pour espérer obtenir un remboursement. Je considère qu’il est totalement anormal qu’un consommateur doive supporter les conséquences financières d’une faute qu’il n’a pas commise.

Cette manière de procéder donne le sentiment que la responsabilité est systématiquement reportée sur le client, alors même que celui-ci est victime de l’erreur. Ce fonctionnement est, à mes yeux, contraire aux principes élémentaires de loyauté commerciale et de respect du consommateur.

J’attendais de SHEIN qu’ils reconnaissent leur erreur et prennent intégralement en charge les frais de retour. Au lieu de cela, j’ai eu le sentiment que l’on cherchait à me faire renoncer à exercer mes droits en m’imposant des coûts supplémentaires.

Je déconseille donc cette plateforme à toute personne qui souhaite bénéficier d’un service client fiable et d’une prise en charge correcte en cas de problème. Tant que les erreurs commises par le vendeur continueront d’être supportées financièrement par les clients, il est difficile d’accorder sa confiance à cette enseigne.

Pour ma part, cette expérience remet sérieusement en cause l’image et la crédibilité de SHEIN, et je réfléchirai à deux fois avant d’y effectuer une nouvelle commande.
Je vous invite également à faire pareil , réfléchissez deux fois avant de commander sur ce site , ALIEXPRESS  et TEMU sont mieux .

review_headline: Avoid SHEIN – Terrible Customer Service and No Accountability
review_body:
I would give 0 stars if I could.

I placed a large order for my holiday and paid extra for fast delivery. According to the tracking, the parcel was left outside my front door while I was not at home. When I returned, it had disappeared. I checked with my neighbours, but no one had taken it in.

Despite repeatedly explaining that I never received the parcel, SHEIN has refused to refund me because their tracking shows it as “delivered.” They continue to tell me to contact their courier myself and obtain evidence that the parcel is missing.

My contract is with SHEIN, not their delivery company. As the retailer, they should be investigating this directly instead of passing the responsibility onto the customer.

The most frustrating part has been the customer service. I have received the same scripted responses over and over, despite asking several times for the matter to be escalated to a manager. There has been no genuine attempt to resolve my complaint.

The order was intended for my holiday, so by the time this was being investigated, I had already travelled and was forced to buy replacement items elsewhere.

After being a customer, this experience has completely destroyed my confidence in SHEIN. I will not be shopping with them again and am now pursuing other avenues to recover my money.

I would strongly advise anyone ordering from SHEIN to be aware that if your parcel is left unattended and goes missing, you may find yourself fighting for a refund despite never receiving your order.

review_headline: My experience with SHEIN India has been…
review_body:
My experience with SHEIN India has been extremely disappointing.

I ordered one pair of jeans and requested a return. Due to an error on SHEIN's side, two pickup requests were generated for the same order. The courier successfully picked up my jeans under the first pickup request, and I have the pickup confirmation message and screenshots as proof.

The second (duplicate) pickup was cancelled by the delivery partner because the item had already been collected. Despite this, SHEIN is claiming that my return was cancelled and has refused to process my refund.

It has now been more than 20 days, and I have sent all the screenshots, pickup confirmation, and proof to the SHEIN India customer care team multiple times through email. Unfortunately, no one has properly reviewed the evidence or provided a genuine resolution. I only receive repetitive responses while my refund remains pending.

This entire situation was caused by an issue in SHEIN's own return process, yet I am the one being made to suffer. The lack of accountability and poor customer service have completely destroyed my trust in this brand.

If you're shopping with SHEIN India, make sure to keep screenshots of every order, pickup confirmation, and email because you may need them later. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend shopping here.

Moreover, I have already shared my order number, pickup confirmation, screenshots, and all the required details multiple times with your customer support team through email. Despite having all the information, my issue has still not been resolved.

review_headline: No Way to Correct an Honest Mistake
review_body:
I had already submitted a return within SHEIN’s return window and was preparing to send the parcel back. Before posting it, I realised I could combine two returns into one parcel, so I attempted to do that. Unfortunately, I clicked the wrong option and accidentally cancelled the return for two hair flowers.

I contacted customer service immediately to explain that it was a genuine mistake and asked if they could simply reinstate the return. Instead, I was repeatedly told that nothing could be done because the system was “blocked” and the items were now ineligible for return, despite the fact that the return had originally been submitted within the permitted timeframe.

What disappointed me most wasn’t the outcome itself, but the complete absence of common sense or discretion. At no point did anyone meaningfully acknowledge the circumstances I had explained. I wasn’t trying to return items outside the policy or exploit the system. I was simply trying to send back two hair flowers under an already authorised return and made one accidental click while attempting to combine parcels.

Good customer service should be able to distinguish between someone attempting to circumvent the rules and a genuine customer who has made an honest mistake. Instead, I received what felt like scripted responses, no meaningful engagement with the issue, and no willingness to explore whether an exception could be made.

If a single accidental click can permanently invalidate a return that was created on time, and customer service has no ability to reverse it or exercise any discretion, then that represents a significant flaw in both the process and the customer experience. Policies are important, but so is fairness.

Sadly, I’ve been left with two hair flowers that I fully intended to return, not because I missed the deadline, but because an irreversible system limitation took precedence over helping a genuine customer. I hope SHEIN reviews this case and offers a fair resolution, as this situation arose from an honest mistake after my return had already been been submitted within the required timeframe.

I never wanted to leave a negative review. I simply wanted someone to listen to what had happened and apply a little common sense. This issue could have been resolved in minutes by reinstating my return. Instead, I’ve spent far longer trying to explain a genuine mistake than it would have taken to resolve it. That’s not the level of customer service I expected, and it has seriously damaged my confidence in SHEIN.

I repeatedly asked for the Visa Acquirer Reference Number (ARN) so that my bank could trace the refund. SHEIN later informed me that no ARN was available and advised me to contact my bank instead.

I followed their instructions. My bank thoroughly checked my account and confirmed that no refund had ever been received.

To make matters even more concerning, the Refund Proof later disappeared from my SHEIN account, although fortunately I had already downloaded a copy to my computer.

I have since told SHEIN that I am happy to receive the refund directly into my SHEIN Wallet instead of my bank account, simply to resolve this matter. I am still waiting for a solution.

I understand that mistakes can happen. My disappointment is not just about £22.72, but about the amount of time, effort and stress it has taken to chase a refund that I still have not received.

I sincerely hope SHEIN will resolve this matter promptly, but based on my experience, I cannot recommend their customer service.

review_headline: Meine Erfahrung mit SHEIN ist von schlecht zu völlig inakzeptabel geworden.
review_body:
Ich hatte bereits gemeldet, dass ich das falsche Kleid erhalten habe. Ich habe ausführlich erklärt, dass Ihr Lager mir ein völlig anderes Kleid geschickt hat als das, das ich bestellt hatte. Außerdem habe ich darauf hingewiesen, dass Ihre Lieferinformationen, die Zuordnung der Pakete, die Sendungsverfolgung und sogar mein Supportfall fehlerhaft waren. Ich habe Fotos und Screenshots beigefügt, die dies eindeutig belegen.

Trotz meiner ausführlichen Erklärung hat niemand meine Beschwerde tatsächlich geprüft. Stattdessen wurde mir wiederholt gesagt, ich solle die Artikel einfach zurücksenden.

Ich habe Ihre Anweisungen befolgt und alle Artikel zurückgeschickt, die ich erhalten habe.

Nun verweigern Sie mir die vollständige Erstattung mit der Begründung, eines der zurückgesendeten Kleider sei „nicht das Kleid, das an mich versendet wurde“.

Das ist schlicht unglaublich.

Das Kleid, dessen Erstattung Sie verweigern, ist genau das Kleid, das Ihr Lager irrtümlich an mich geschickt hat. Genau deshalb habe ich die ursprüngliche Beschwerde eingereicht. Ich habe das von mir bestellte Kleid niemals erhalten. Stattdessen bekam ich ein völlig anderes Kleid, habe dies sofort gemeldet, Fotos als Nachweis geschickt und Ihrem Kundenservice die Situation wiederholt erklärt.

Ihre Unterlagen waren von Anfang an fehlerhaft. Ihr System zeigte Lieferungen an, die nie stattgefunden haben, ordnete Artikel und Pakete falsch zu und stufte sogar meine Beschwerde unter einem völlig falschen Anliegen ein. Dennoch hat niemand einen dieser Fehler berücksichtigt.

Anstatt den Fehler Ihres eigenen Lagers zu untersuchen, nutzen Sie diesen Fehler nun als Begründung dafür, mir einen Teil meiner Rückerstattung zu verweigern.

Ich erwarte die Erstattung des noch ausstehenden Betrags für dieses Kleid – 26,38 € abzüglich des auf diesen Artikel entfallenden Neukundenrabatts. Ich habe genau das zurückgeschickt, was ich von SHEIN erhalten habe. Ich sollte kein Geld verlieren müssen, nur weil Ihr Lager und Ihr Kundenservice Fehler gemacht haben.

Nach dieser Erfahrung werde ich nie wieder bei SHEIN bestellen. Der gesamte Service, die Bearbeitung von Beschwerden und der Kundenservice waren vollkommen inakzeptabel.

Ich fordere, dass diese Angelegenheit umgehend geklärt wird. Ich möchte mein Geld zurück – heute. Es gibt keinerlei Rechtfertigung dafür, meine Rückerstattung wegen eines Fehlers zu verweigern, den SHEIN selbst verursacht hat.

review_headline: MANCANZA DI CORRETTEZZA. NON VOGLIONO DARMI IL RIMBORSO PER UN PRODOTTO RESO IN PERFETTE CONDIZIONI
review_body:
P.S. 29/07/2026 Aggiungo che Shein mi ha scritto scusandosi, ma ancora si rifiuta di farmi il rimborso, come avevo chiesto e continuo a chiedere sul mio Satispay. Intanto ho fatto la Segnalazione alla Autorità AGCM e non è finita. L'importo è minimo ma la scorrettezza di SHEIN è infinita.
Con fatica e molte telefonate sono riuscita a rendere un prodotto e chiesto il rimborso su Satispay da dove avevo pagato. Ma dopo più di 2 mesi il rimborso non è arrivato. Ho fatto parecchie telefonate, sospendendole durante il periodo delle mie ferie e solo oggi con l'ultima telefonata scopro che praticamente non ho più diritto al rimborso, perché non me lo hanno mandato su Satispay (come avevo chiesto), ma me lo hanno dato sotto forma di credito sul portafoglio Shein (?), ma chi glielo ha chiesto, e che comunque è scaduto, perché potevo spenderlo solo fino a una certa data. Ma stiamo scherzando? I miei soldi? Io ho diritto al rimborso, ho diritto di spendervi come, dove e quando dico io, non sul loro sito ne tanto più con una scadenza. E l'operatore mi ha detto che tanto non me li daranno mai indietro. Scorrettezza assoluta, da denuncia. Fate attenzione! Oltre alla pessima qualità della merce, ci si può trovare in queste spiacevoli situazioni. Peccato, leggo solo adesso esperienze negative simili alla mia. Quindi, non sono la sola fregata. Ed anche io sto guardando per una segnalazione all'Autorità AGCM e non solo. Grazie per le recensioni.
